glossary.definition: (A) "Active tuberculosis" means tuberculosis that has been demonstrated by clinical, bacteriological, or radiographic evidence to be present in an individual who has not completed an appropriate course of antituberculosis medication, regardless of the stage of communicability of the tuberculosis, and includes both pulmonary and extrapulmonary tuberculosis.
glossary.scope: As used in this section and sections 339.72 to 339.89 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (B) "Communicable tuberculosis" means active pulmonary or laryngeal tuberculosis that has been determined, through examination of a culture of specimens obtained from the individual's respiratory tract, to be in a stage at which it can be transmitted to another individual.
glossary.scope: As used in this section and sections 339.72 to 339.89 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (C) "Extrapulmonary tuberculosis" means tuberculosis that affects tissues of the body other than the lungs.
glossary.scope: As used in this section and sections 339.72 to 339.89 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (D) "Laryngeal tuberculosis" means tuberculosis that affects the larynx.
glossary.scope: As used in this section and sections 339.72 to 339.89 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (E) "Physician" means an individual authorized under Chapter 4731. of the Revised Code to practice medicine and surgery or osteopathic medicine and surgery.
glossary.scope: As used in this section and sections 339.72 to 339.89 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (F) "Pulmonary tuberculosis" means tuberculosis that affects the lungs.
